# TapMenu Grand Resort & Spa

> TapMenu Grand Resort & Spa is a hospitality property located at 100 Hospitality Boulevard, Metropolis. Rooms start at ₹2,000 a night. Check-in and check-out are both at 11:00 AM. It features a multi-cuisine pure vegetarian restaurant, an indoor banquet hall for around 120 guests, and an outdoor function lawn for around 1,500 to 2,000 guests.

Bookings can be initiated online or requested via messaging channels, where the front desk confirms availability and final pricing.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the resort, rooms, dining, events, facilities, guest reviews and location.
- [Rooms](/rooms): Deluxe Room and Super Deluxe Room accommodation options with comparisons and amenities.
- [Weddings & Events](/weddings-events): Banquet hall and function lawn venues for celebrations, corporate gatherings and weddings.
- [Dining](/dining): Pure vegetarian North Indian, regional specialties and international dishes with full menu listings.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Architectural photographs of the lobby, guest rooms, event spaces and grounds.
- [About & Facilities](/about): Property architecture, operational amenities and guest services.
- [Contact & FAQs](/contact): Contact numbers, messaging links, map directions, policies and guest FAQs.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): Transparent data protection, privacy terms and account management policies.

## Key facts

- Address: 100 Hospitality Boulevard, Grand Central Plaza, Metropolis 100001
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98765 43210, +91 98765 43211
- Email: contact@example.com
- Rooms: Deluxe ₹2,000 a night, Super Deluxe ₹2,200 a night. Extra bed available on request.
- Amenities: Air conditioning, Wi-Fi, television, ensuite bathroom, private balcony, hot-water geyser.
- Check-in and check-out: 11:00 AM. Government-issued photo ID required at check-in.
- Payments accepted: Cash, UPI, credit and debit cards.
- Facilities: Restaurant, banquet hall, function lawn, on-site parking, guest elevator, room service, power backup, CCTV security.
